name: lucra
description: Run Lucra from ChatGPT: creator programs, applications, videos, creator ads on Meta, TikTok, Google and Snapchat, results by creator, and creator payouts.

interface.longDescription:
Lucra is where brands run creator marketing end to end. Connect your Lucra account and ask in plain words; answers come back as Lucra's own cards and charts.

- Needs you: creator applications, videos and sample requests waiting on you, and ads that need attention.
- Programs: create a program from a short brief, invite creators, open it to the Lucra Network.
- Videos: watch creators' submissions, approve them or ask for changes.
- Creator ads: your campaigns on Meta, TikTok, Google and Snapchat; pause or resume them.
- Results: spend, sales and return by creator, video or campaign from Lucra's own attribution, charted over time.
- Payments: what you've paid creators, and bonuses or one-off payments after you confirm.

Who it's for: brands, agencies and partners with a Lucra account. It acts as the member who connected it, with their role; connect read-only if you only want answers.

Limits: anything that spends or moves money, launches ads, or ends, archives or removes something asks you to confirm first. Uploading videos and files happens in the Lucra app.
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention in Lucra?
Chart my creator ad spend and sales for the last 30 days
Who are my top 5 creators by sales this month?

positive.description: Finds everything waiting on the brand.
positive.prompt: What needs my attention in Lucra?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls applications_find and submissions_find with status pending and campaigns_find with status needs_attention, shows them as cards and says what to do first, or says nothing is waiting.

positive.description: Lists the brand's creator programs with their status.
positive.prompt: List my creator programs and say which are live.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls programs_find, shows the programs as cards and names which are open.

positive.prompt: Who are my top 5 creators by sales in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls tally on ad_results grouped by creator, summing revenue, and answers with the five creators and their sales.

positive.prompt: Chart my creator ad spend and sales by day for the last 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Counts daily spend and sales with tally on ad_results, then calls chart with those numbers and summarizes the trend in a sentence.
Reads campaigns and their results, names the campaign it will pause and asks to confirm, then calls campaigns_update with status paused after the user agrees.

negative.description: Moving money to a personal account isn't something Lucra does; ChatGPT shouldn't call payment tools for it.
negative.prompt: Send $500 from my Lucra account to my personal Venmo.

negative.description: A general writing request unrelated to the brand's Lucra data needs no Lucra tool.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about summer.

negative.description: Another company's private Lucra data isn't reachable; the connection only sees the account that authorized it.
negative.prompt: Show me Nike's creator programs and what they pay creators.

publication.release_notes: Fewer, clearer tools: a find tool per kind of record (list, or get one by ID), one tool per change, ad_results for performance, plus tally, chart and docs; results show as Lucra cards and charts; creators can connect their own profile; seven skills.
